interface.shortDescription: Search live contract tech jobs across sources.
interface.longDescription: Find live technology contracts across sources with no account or API key. Filter by role, location, seniority, hourly rate and documented 1099, C2C or W-2 contract arrangements. Match stack terms in job titles. Get up to five concise results with source evidence, freshness and RadarJobs links. Remote eligibility and unknown compensation remain explicit.
defaultPrompt: Find contracts paying at least 80 USD per hour.
